Atmosphere.description:
Sun, sky, fog and grade: a preset and the fields that
differ from it. Colors are linear RGB and may exceed 1.

aerial_color.description: The color distant ridges fade into away from the sun.

aerial_density.description: Aerial extinction per world unit at height zero; 0 turns it off.

aerial_falloff.description: How fast the air thins with height, per world unit.

aerial_glow.description:
How strongly distant ridges fade into a glow of the sun's color

aerial_start.description:
Aerial perspective begins this far from the camera (world
units): beyond it, air dims what lies behind it toward the light
it scatters. Unlike fog it is unbounded and spans kilometers.

ambient.description: Scale of the sky's ambient light on surfaces.

contrast.description:
Contrast around mid grey after tone mapping: the slope of an
S-curve that keeps black and white; 0 flattens, 1 keeps it, and
the curve is steepest at 1.5.

emission.description:
Scale of material emission: how strongly lamps, lit windows and
other artificial lights show in this light, dim by day and full
at night.

fog_density.description: Fog density per world unit at height zero.

fog_falloff.description: How fast fog thins with height, per world unit.

fog_start.description: Fog begins this far from the camera (world units).

ground.description:
Sky color below the horizon: downward surfaces take their
ambient light from it.

horizon.description:
Sky color at the horizon: vertical surfaces take their ambient
light from it.

preset.description: The preset the other fields override.

rim.description:
Silhouette light in the horizon color, facing away from the
camera.

saturation.description: Saturation after tone mapping; 1 keeps it.

shadow_tint.description:
Hue of dark tones after tone mapping (split toning), as a color
gain scaled to keep luminance; white, like black, keeps them.
Cool shadows against warm highlights read as vivid.

specular.description:
Scale of sun highlights and sky reflections; 1 is physically
based.

sun_direction.description:
Direction toward the sun; any nonzero length, normalized when
rendered.

vibrance.description:
Saturation added to muted colors more than to vivid ones; 0 adds
none.

zenith.description:
Sky color straight up: upward surfaces take their ambient light
from it.

StampOp.description:
What a stamp does where it reaches: raise or lower heights by meters,
level them toward a height, or cut holes in the terrain.

oneOf.description:
Cells whose centers lie within the radius are holes: no surface

TerrainView.description:
What terrain shows: its material, or for development its

oneOf.description: Each surface material in its own color, blended as the ground is.

BrowserControl.description:
Host controls available alongside read-only [`DevRequest`] operations.
The browser host enforces pause/lifecycle rules. Parsing validates
structure and the protocol version; the host also validates finite values,
ranges, and u64 revision parsing before changing state.

oneOf.description:
Preview fixed-tick poses at a chosen fraction without advancing clocks.
Requires pause; ordinary step/render/capture retain authoritative poses.

gpu.description:
Present through GPU blending/composition/culling
instead of the exact CPU path; for comparisons.

oneOf.description: Temporarily toggle visibility culling and render without advancing clocks.

Temporarily replace environment sections and render while paused.
Sections are a scene `environment`'s, validated alike; omitted
sections stay. A scene with an environment restores its own on
reload; persist a look by saving it there.

merge.description:
Whether a named section's omitted fields keep their current
values instead of taking their defaults.

oneOf.description:
Temporarily set terrain's level of detail and view and
render while paused: `pixel_error` replaces the settings', `freeze`
keeps streaming and patches following the camera's
current position while the camera moves on, and `view` shows terrain
shaded or its levels, normals, tiles and patches, materials, sky
visibility or detail. Omitted fields stay as they
are.

Temporarily edit a generated terrain over its layers and bakes
and render while paused: `change` raises or lowers the
ground by meters, levels it to a world height or cuts holes in it, at
full strength within `radius` meters of world `center` `[x, z]` and
fading over `falloff` more, under `id` (letters, digits, `_`, `-` and
`.`), which repeating leaves the terrain alone. Only the tiles
under it regenerate. Returns whether it applied, the edits standing,
where tiles regenerate (world `min` and `max` `[x, z]`) and the most
the ground moved (meters). `terrain` names a scene's terrain entity
(the first terrain when omitted). The `Terrain` inspector lists the
edits as stamp layers to save into the scene.

Take the terrain's last edit away and render while
paused; `terrain` as for `terrain_edit`.

Put back the last edit undo took away, unless an edit came since,
and render while paused.

Press a track as a deformer would, now, and render
while paused: a capsule `radius` meters across from world `from`
`[x, z]` to `to` (a footprint at `from` when omitted), sinking ground
as deformable as that `depth` meters along its middle, round
(`flatness` 0) to flat (1). `clear`
forgets every track first. Not a source change: the log and the map
keep it until cleared or refilled. Returns the stamp, the stamps the
log holds and whether deformation is enabled.

Send navigation agent `entity` (authored ID) walking to world
`destination` `[x, z]`, or stop it with null, and
render while paused; steps then walk it. Not a source change.
Returns its status.

Set an authored entity's animation player and render while paused:
its clip (an animation ID of the scene), time in seconds, speed and
looping; omitted values stay. Returns them before and after.

Remove streamed items for good, or restore them, by
ID (`scene/root` for scenes), and render while
paused: `clear` restores every item first. Loaded cells despawn and
spawn them at once. Not a source change: WorldChanges keeps them,
as a game's save would. Returns how many items are removed.

Set a complete temporary world-space camera and render while paused.
Its values keep the rules of scenes' cameras (`SceneCamera`), the
field of view in radians.

RAF-paced host sampling, bounded to ten seconds; advances one tick per
sample in step mode and no gameplay in render/present modes. Present mode
samples existing fixed-tick history at alpha 0.5. Clears pending input.

Advance exactly `ticks` fixed ticks, then one presentation/render
boundary.

Run `count` ordinary frames `interval_ms` apart while paused, as play
runs them after a pause: the first advances no time, each later one
`interval_ms`, without input (pending input is cleared), presented
and antialiased as play's are; then stay paused. With `capture`,
the host captures the last frame as it was drawn, without drawing
again, as `capture` keeps its files.
Replace the temporary batch applied on the next explicit step.
Extract and render current state without advancing gameplay.

Render while paused and wait for presentation before host capture.
Omitted alpha renders authoritative current state; a supplied fraction
previews existing fixed-tick history without advancing gameplay.

gpu.description:
With `alpha`, capture GPU presentation instead of
the exact CPU path.

oneOf.description:
Runs the game's own control `name` with `args`, as the page
registers it (a Stress Lab workload, look or view), then renders.
The bridge's describe lists the game's controls.

args.description: The control's arguments, a JSON object.

oneOf.description: Fetch saved source and require both expected runtime and source revisions.

Panics the engine, as a bug in it would, to check what the host does
then: the engine stops for good, and every later request answers
`runtime_panicked` with the panic's message and where it happened.

Fails the renderer's lazily created feature `feature` as a GPU error
would: its next creation makes an invalid object, which its first
frame uses. The renderer disables it alone; then renders.

Camera.description:
Right-handed Y-up perspective. Lens distances use world units; 0 < near <
far; FOV is in radians.
Camera.title: CameraView

Clouds.description: The cloud layer. Opt-in: a scene without a `clouds` section has none.

base.description: The world height of its base, meters.

coverage.description: How much of the sky it covers: 0 clear, 1 overcast.

in_view.description:
Whether the view marches the clouds after the opaque scene: then
they stand in front of whatever lies beyond them, all around a camera
inside the layer and below one above it, and the dome shows them
behind every surface only while the camera is under the layer.

resolution.description:
The dome's texels around the horizon; a quarter as many from the
horizon up.

scale.description: The meters across its largest shapes.

shadows.description: How much of the sun's light its shadows take from the ground.

slices.description: The frames over which ordinary frames march the whole dome.

view_block.description: The pixels along a side of the blocks the view marches a ray each.

wind.description: The wind it drifts in, meters per second along x and z.

Clouds.title: SceneClouds

Collider.description:
Local cuboid/sphere, symmetric layer filters and sensor flag. Current
authoritative world admission and refreshed collision-cache status are
independent of visibility and interpolation.

cache_status.description:
Active/invalid in the refreshed cache; not_cached includes overflow;
unavailable means the plugin is absent.

world_valid.description: Admission of the current authoritative world transform, independent of visibility.

Collider.title: ColliderView

CollisionWorld.description:
Authoritative spatial cache refreshed for inspection without advancing
clocks or committing sensor events. Includes source frame/tick, cache
revision, completeness, invalid/overflow counts and query budgets. Memory
counts are cache payload, not process totals.

cache_bytes.description: Reserved collision cache payload; not total process memory.

placed_colliders.description: Placed objects colliding within terrains' collision radius.

revision.description: Cache revision and source clocks are decimal strings, not runtime handles.

CollisionWorld.title: CollisionWorldView

distance.description:
Meters from the camera within which surfaces trace, their shadows
fading out over its last third.

length.description: How far each ray reaches toward the sun, in meters.

strength.description: How much of the sun's light a hit takes away; 0 turns them off.

SceneDecalBlend.description: How a decal combines with the surface it lies on.

oneOf.description: Covering by alpha, lit like any surface: paint, posters, markings.

Multiplying the surface's color, keeping its light: dirt, cracks,
stains and scorch marks.

Decal.description:
A decal on this entity as a scene's `decal` field: its material
projected down the entity's local y onto the opaque surfaces inside its unit
box, fading on surfaces turning away beyond `fade_degrees`.

material.description: The material's authored ID; None when no scene instance owns it.

material_alive.description: Whether the material is still resident.

Decal.title: DecalView

max_decals.description:
An optional budget of decals a frame draws; beyond it the decals
nearest the camera win. Omitted, every decal draws.

extent.description: The meters of ground the map around the camera spans.

max_stamps.description:
An optional budget of stamps the log keeps, the oldest dropping
beyond it.

persist.description:
Whether the log keeps the stamps the map moves away from, so tracks
are there when the camera returns.

refill.description:
The seconds tracks take to refill to about a third of their depth;
0 never.

resolution.description:
The map's texels along a side; renderers keep fewer where the
device's buffers cannot hold them.

rim.description: How high the ground rises beside a track for its depth.

Deformer.description:
Presses tracks into deformable ground as a scene's `deformer`
field: each fixed tick, while its entity's world position lies at most
`contact` meters above the terrain under it (or below it), it presses a
footprint from where it pressed the tick before. Put it where an object
meets the ground: a wheel's or a foot's lowest point.

contact.description: Meters above the terrain within which it presses.

depth.description:
Meters it sinks ground as deformable as that along its middle,
deeper by however far it lies below the ground.

flatness.description:
Its footprint's shape: 0 round, deepest along its middle like a
wheel's rut; 1 flat, a foot's or a plate's level floor.

radius.description: Meters across the footprint it presses.

Deformer.title: Deformer

Floating.description:
Rides the sea: each fixed tick the entity rises and falls with the sea's
surface under it and leans about its own heading. Unparented entities
only; nothing moves without an enabled sea.

draft.description: Meters of it below the surface.

tilt.description: How far it leans: 0 upright, 1 with the surface's normal.

Floating.title: SceneFloating

Applied.description: Whether the frame applied an effect its settings ask for.

CellStats.description: World streaming's state after the last extraction.

pending.description: Cells within range still waiting to load.

rows.description:
Rows of the clouds' dome this frame marched: all of them on exact
frames, a slice on ordinary ones, none without clouds.

view_blocks.description:
Blocks of the view whose clouds this frame marched: none without
clouds or with their march in the view off.

CullingStats.description: What GPU culling ran and left undrawn.

active.description:
Whether this GPU-presented display frame ran it, without an instance
budget (occlusion culling draws in two phases around its test).

instances.description:
Visible instances it left undrawn (occluded, or covering no pixel
center), read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

stamps.description: Stamps this frame pressed into the map around the camera.

texels.description:
The map's texels along a side: 0 while off, fewer than the settings'
where the device's buffers cannot hold them.

dropped_impostors.description:
Opaque draw groups that qualified for impostors but draw their meshes
because a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left them none.

failed_meshes.description:
Meshes whose levels of detail simplification refused since the
renderer started, each drawn with the levels made before (none when
it refused the first): only meshes beyond what 32-bit indices
address; the renderer's `latest_lod_failure` says why the latest was.

impostor_instances.description: Instances drawn as impostors, read back like `lod0_instances`.

lod0_instances.description:
GPU-culled frames with levels of detail: instances drawn as their
mesh, read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

lod1_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's first simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

lod2_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's second simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

Drawn.description: What a feature drew, and what a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

dropped.description: Items a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

invalid.description: Items breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

blades.description: Blades the last read-back frame drew.

dropped.description: Blades past the capacity or budget, which dropped.

reach.description: Meters from the eye ground cover reached this frame, rounded.

tiers.description: The most tiers it grew in: the radius's and doublings past it.

JobStats.description: Workers, their jobs and the host's output cache.

cache_hits.description: Outputs the host's cache handed back instead of running their jobs.

cache_mismatches.description: Verifying, cached outputs differing from a fresh run.

held.description:
Jobs the host's scheduler holds: on its workers, or looked up in its
cache. None once every job handed out ended, an earlier engine's
included.

running.description: Jobs handed out and not done.

cluster_overflow.description:
Cluster entries beyond the clusters' budget or the storage still
growing, read back like `visible`.

dropped.description: Usable lights beyond the budget or without a valid pose.

invalid.description: Lights breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

shaded.description: Local lights the frame shaded within the budget.

visible.description:
Lights that reached a view cluster, read back a few frames late;
`None` before the first read-back or without lights.

NavStats.description:
What navigation did at the last fixed tick: agents, and
those searching, walking, arrived and unable to reach their
destination; and the samples of search work the tick did.

searching.description: Agents whose walk is being searched.

unreachable.description: Agents whose destination no walk reaches.

work.description: Samples of search work the tick did.

OccupancyStats.description: The occupancy map around the camera.

redraws.description:
Times the map was drawn: it follows the camera in steps and redraws
when objects change.

PhysicsStats.description: Physics at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

awake.description: Of them, awake: moving, or pushed this tick.

contacts.description: Contacts touching between bodies and solids or each other.

held.description:
Of them, held still where the world's solids under them are not
resident yet.

solids.description:
The world's solids the solver holds for bodies to meet: terrain
tiles, placed objects and colliders near them.

water_samples.description: Samples of the world's water the tick's bodies took.

dropped.description: Probes a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left out.

ready.description: Probes surfaces could reflect this frame.

active.description: Whether the sun cast shadows this frame.

draws.description:
Indexed draws into the shadow maps, beside the camera pass's
`draw_calls`.

kept_casters.description:
Casters the kept map drew, read back like the near map's: redraws
only.

kept_redraw.description:
The kept map's redraw: 0 none, 1 a rectangle of dirty tiles, 2 the
whole map (every still caster).

level_casters.description: Casters the kept levels drew, read back like the near map's.

levels_pending.description: Kept-level tiles no level holds yet: lookups read coarser maps there.

moving_casters.description:
Casters the moving map drew, read back like the near map's: in a
settled scene, the moving renderables.

near_casters.description:
Casters the near map drew, read back a few frames late; `None` before
the first read-back.

tables.description:
Tables this frame built: two when its air changed, one more when the
sun, the camera's height or the air changed; none without the sky.

dropped_materials.description:
Surface materials past the palette's capacity, or whose maps the
shared arrays cannot hold (block compressed, or sized unlike the first
material's), which show a plain color instead.

dropped_placed_objects.description:
Placed objects the device's storage bindings left out: those past
what the objects' buffers hold, and entries past what the views'
lists hold, once each view and level leaving them out, read back a
few frames late.

dropped_tiles.description: Tiles the tile budget or the device's texture array layers dropped.

dropped_vt_pages.description:
Virtual texture pages asked for with no slot left under its budget or
the device's texture array layers.

fallback_patches.description: Patches standing in for finer levels not resident yet.

gpu_controls.description: Tiles the GPU gave control values this frame.

horizons.description: Terrains casting long sun shadows through horizon maps.

placed_far_objects.description:
Of those, objects standing far away, which hide where the tiles
holding them instead are resident.

placed_impostors.description:
Placed objects' impostors baked, which the camera draws far away and
shadow maps cast as cards; counted in `level_of_detail.impostors` too.

placed_objects.description:
Objects placement layers stand on resident level-0 tiles, each culled
on the GPU every frame.

sky_maps.description: Terrains whose sky visibility maps are built.

sky_rows.description: Rows of sky visibility maps this frame built.

unplaced_tiles.description:
Resident tiles lacking objects their levels place with nothing
under way to place them: none unless streaming lost track of them.

vt_bakes.description: Virtual texture pages baked this frame (absent or stale).

vt_evictions.description: Virtual texture pages evicted for others this frame.

vt_missing.description:
Virtual texture pages asked for but absent, in the last feedback read
back.

vt_slots.description: Pages the runtime virtual texture's sheets hold.

VirtualGeometryStats.description: Virtual geometry, read back a few frames late.

dropped.description: Cluster selections dropped while their storage grew.

dropped_pages.description:
Wanted pages (with arrivals since) that found no room under the
budget or the device's limits.

failed_pages.description:
Page reads that failed or held no valid page since streaming
started, each read again later; the renderer's
`latest_page_failure` says why the latest did.

missing_pages.description:
Pages the last read-back frame wanted and lacked: 0 once its view had
all the detail it asked for.

occluded_clusters.description: The camera's clusters occlusion culling left undrawn.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the visibility buffer resolved the camera's virtual geometry
rather than drawing it forward.

WaterStats.description: Terrains' water, as their tiles hold it.

blocks.description: Blocks of tiles' water resident on the GPU, a patch's each.

dropped_blocks.description:
Blocks this frame dropped for want of the device's texture array
layers, whose water does not draw.

FrameStats.description:
CPU observations from the last submitted frame and the renderer's report
of it. Render time is not GPU time.

culled_instances.description: Valid instances culling proved outside the view.

disabled_features.description:
The renderer's features it disabled for good, by name: one whose
creation failed validation, or that an uncaptured GPU error named
by its objects' labels. Frames render without them.

draw_calls.description:
Draw commands of the camera's mesh passes, each counted once however
many occlusion phases issue it: each opaque mesh group's, one per
level of detail on GPU-presented frames, the impostors', virtual
geometry's forward bins and the transparent groups'. `shadows.draws`
counts the shadow maps'.

dropped_instances.description: Visible instances the instance budget left undrawn.

dropped_seconds.description: Total simulation time discarded by the fixed-step budget in this session.

dropped_view_pixels.description:
Pixels of the view the host asked for that the device's largest
texture left out.

extraction_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent extracting the render snapshot.

fixed_steps.description: Fixed simulation ticks this frame ran.

frame.description: The frame these stats describe, as `FrameTime::frame` counts it.

instances.description:
Number of mesh instances submitted (before GPU clipping). GPU-culled
frames report the read-back visible count limited by the instance
budget, or the budgeted candidate count before any read-back.

invalid_transforms.description:
Renderable entities skipped because their derived transform is
invalid.

jobs.description: The host's workers and their jobs, read when the stats are.

loading.description:
Whether terrains have yet to load the camera's view whole, read
when the stats are: hosts keep preparing meanwhile.

mesh_upload_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes initialized for meshes first seen this frame.

missing_assets.description:
Renderable entities skipped because a mesh, material, or texture is
absent.

navigation.description: Navigation agents at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

physics.description: Rigid bodies at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

pipelines_compiling.description:
Whether the GPU may still be compiling pipelines earlier frames
created, read when the stats are.

pipelines_created.description:
Pipelines this frame created: 0 once everything the scene draws is
compiled.

read_back_age.description:
GPU-culled frames only: how many GPU-presented frames late the counts
read back with the visible count (`instances`, `triangles`,
`occlusion_culling`, `subpixel_culling` and `level_of_detail`'s
instances) are, 1 when they arrived as soon as they could, more while
the GPU falls behind; `None` before the first read-back. A check that
changed what they count presents until this is below the frames it
presented since.

render_candidates.description: Every entity carrying a mesh, before transform and asset checks.

render_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent preparing and submitting GPU work.

render_passes.description: The passes this frame ran, in order.

resident_mesh_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_meshes.description: Number of distinct meshes retained on the GPU.

resident_texture_bytes.description: Asset texel bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_textures.description: Number of asset textures retained on the GPU, excluding renderer white.

simulation_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent in fixed and variable simulation.

texture_upload_bytes.description: Texel bytes uploaded for textures first seen this frame.

tick.description:
The last fixed tick that frame completed, as `FixedTime::tick`
counts it.

triangles.description:
Triangles the camera's mesh draws submitted, at their levels of
detail and impostors' two each: exact on CPU-prepared frames, read
back with the visible count on GPU-culled ones. Virtual geometry
counts its own in `virtual_geometry.triangles`.

upload_bytes.description:
Actual bytes uploaded or initialized: changed camera/instances and new
assets. An unchanged rendered frame can submit draws with zero upload
bytes. Excludes renderer startup resources such as the four-byte white
texture.

view_height.description: The view's height in physical pixels, as the frame drew it.

view_width.description:
The view's width in physical pixels, as the frame drew it: the
host's, unless the device's largest texture holds less, which the
view then fits within at its aspect.

visible_instances.description:
Valid instances surviving culling, before the instance budget;
GPU-culled frames report the latest read-back count.

FrameStats.title: FrameStats

GlobalTransform.description:
Derived world transform, refreshed before inspection. Column-major matrix
preserves shear; invalid hierarchies return null matrix and translation and
skip rendering.

matrix.description: Column-major matrix; preserves shear from rotated, nonuniform ancestors.

GlobalTransform.title: GlobalTransformView

density.description: Scales every cover's density. Blades sway in the world's `Wind`.

max_blades.description: An optional budget of blades a frame; beyond it the farthest drop.

pixels.description:
How tall on screen (pixels) the average blade stands where tiers
end: each tier reaches twice as far as the last, with blades sparser
and wider, until its blades would stand shorter than this. 0 grows
cover within the radius alone.

radius.description:
Meters from the camera within which cover grows densest. Past it the
ground shows as its cover's canopy, and sparser tiers of wider blades
reach on.

Grounded.description:
Stands on the terrain as a scene's `grounded` field: the entity's
translation's y is kept `offset` meters above the ground under it, from the
finest terrain tile resident there, sampling again as finer tiles arrive and
when its x, z or offset changes; with the level of the tile it last stood
on. Unparented entities only.
Grounded.title: GroundedView

Hierarchy.description:
Current parent and source prefab metadata. IDs are authored IDs, never
runtime handles. Use inspect with parent to page direct children.

authored_parent.description: Parent recorded in source, which may differ after runtime reparenting.

parent.description: Current parent authored ID, if the parent has scene metadata.

parent_alive.description: None for roots; false for a removed runtime parent.

parent_in_active_scene.description: Whether parent is addressable by ID in this inspection's scene instance.

Hierarchy.title: HierarchyView

Input.description:
The host input the last frame brought: movement held in [-1, 1], look
deltas in CSS pixels, and the game actions held, by action number.
Input.title: InputView

InterpolateTransform.description:
Opt-in marker for fixed-tick interpolation of this local transform.
Descendants inherit the presented parent matrix. Gameplay and authored
transforms remain authoritative.

enabled.description: Marker presence opts this local transform into fixed-tick interpolation.

InterpolateTransform.title: InterpolateTransformView

Jobs.description:
The host's job workers: workers (none keeps bakes, tiles and walks on the
engine's thread), jobs in flight, submitted, completed, failed and
cancelled, parts handed back early, keys shared and their bytes, and the
page's output cache. Workers run their most urgent job a slice at a time.
Pages take ?workers=N or off, and ?jobcache=off, verify or a budget in MiB.

cache_hits.description:
The host's output cache: outputs it handed back
instead of running their jobs, jobs it lacked, its bytes and,
verifying, outputs that differed from a fresh run.

held.description:
Jobs the host's scheduler holds: on its workers, or looked up in its
cache; none once every job handed out ended, an earlier engine's
included.

last_failure.description: The latest failed job's message, if any failed.

parts.description:
Parts of outputs handed back before the rest, as
tiles' shapes.

Jobs.title: JobsView

LevelOfDetail.description:
Level of detail settings: whether instances draw
simplified levels of their meshes, and impostors, where the
simplification stays within a pixel error.

fade_seconds.description:
Seconds placed objects take to fade between how the camera shows
them, from 0 (at once).

impostors.description: Whether draw groups draw impostors where they fit.

max_impostors.description: The most impostors kept baked; omitted for no budget.

pixel_error.description:
The largest simplification error a drawn level may show, in pixels
of the viewport height: smaller draws finer levels farther away.

LevelOfDetail.title: SceneLevelOfDetail

SceneSpot.description: The cone of a spot light.

direction.description: Direction the cone points in the entity's local space; nonzero.

inner_angle_degrees.description: Half-angle inside which the light is full, in degrees.

outer_angle_degrees.description:
Half-angle beyond which it is dark, in degrees: at least the inner
angle.

LocalLight.description:
A point or spot light on this entity.
On an entity with a mesh it follows the mesh's displayed pose.

offset.description: Position in the entity's local space, scaled with it.

range.description: World distance beyond which the light has no effect.

spot.description: A cone; omitted for light in every direction.

LocalLight.title: SceneLight

distance.description:
View distance beyond which local light fades out: distant lights
cost no shading.

intensity.description: Scales every light's intensity, e.g. to dim lamps by day.

lights_per_cluster.description:
An optional budget of lights one view cluster lists. Omitted, every
light reaching a cluster shades there.

max_lights.description:
An optional budget of lights a frame shades; beyond it the nearest to
the camera win. Omitted, every light shades.

LodLevelView.description: One coarser level of detail of a mesh.

error.description: Its largest geometric deviation from the mesh, in mesh units.

MeshOrigin.description:
Where an instance's mesh came from, without its vertices: its
[`crate::MeshSource`] as inspectors report it.

oneOf.description: Authored vertex by vertex: how many vertices and indices.
An engine mesh buffer file beside the scene.

A virtual mesh file beside the scene, drawn elsewhere as its most
detailed cut of at most `fallback_triangles` triangles.

MeshRenderView.description: What the renderer made of a mesh drawn with this entity's material.

impostor.description:
Whether an impostor card of it with this material is baked; None where
it never draws as one.

levels.description:
Its coarser levels of detail, finest first; GPU-culled frames choose
among them and the mesh itself by distance.

skinned.description: Whether it uploaded with skin joints, which draw at full detail.

MeshView.description: A mesh as a scene authors it and what the renderer made of it.

colors.description:
Whether its vertices carry colors and second texture coordinates,
and how many joints their skin weights address (0 without).

id.description: Its authored mesh ID; None when no scene instance owns it.

rendered.description:
What the renderer made of it; None where no renderer answers or before
it uploads.

source.description: Where a scene made it from; None for meshes games made.

virtual_geometry.description: Its cluster hierarchy, for virtual meshes.

SceneGrounding.description:
The ground staining the base of an object standing on terrain:
the linear color its color is multiplied by where it meets the
ground, and how many units of its mesh up the stain fades out, from the
ground's slope under it.

SceneMap.description:
A material's use of a texture: its ID, or a map with glTF sampler and
`KHR_texture_transform` settings.

SceneMaterial.description:
One named material; color channels are linear values in `[0, 1]` and
alpha is 1. `opacity` below 1 draws it transparent unless `alpha_mode`
says otherwise. glTF's texture maps, emissive color, alpha modes and
double-sided surfaces complete it; `surface`
roughness and metalness are glTF's roughness and metallic factors.

alpha_cutoff.description: With `mask` only: alpha below it is not drawn; default 0.5.

alpha_mode.description:
How alpha (opacity times base color texture alpha) is
used. Default `blend` below opacity 1, `opaque` otherwise.

double_sided.description: Draw back faces too, lit from their own side.

emissive.description:
Emitted linear color, not negative (glTF's emissive factor
times its emissive strength).

grounding.description: The ground staining the base of objects terrains place.

ior.description:
With `transmission`: the index of refraction in `[1, 3]`;
default 1.5.

metallic_roughness_texture.description: Linear green multiplies roughness and blue metalness.

normal_scale.description: Scales the normal map's deflection; default 1.

normal_texture.description: A tangent-space normal map (green up the image).

occlusion_strength.description: How much the occlusion map darkens, in `[0, 1]`; default 1.

opacity.description:
The fraction of light behind it the surface covers, in `(0, 1]`.
Below 1 it draws transparent, blending in any order,
writing no depth and casting no shadow. With
`alpha_mode` `mask` it is the alpha the cutoff tests.

surface.description:
How the surface responds to light beyond its color; without it the
material is matte.

texture.description:
Base color texture: its sRGB color multiplies `color`. A texture ID,
which repeats, or a map with sampler and transform settings.

thickness.description:
With `transmission`: the depth in world units of the
volume beneath the surface that bends rays; default 0, a thin wall.

top.description:
A layer settling on faces turned up, such as moss,
lichen, dust or snow.

transmission.description:
The share of light passing through the surface instead of
diffusing off it, in `[0, 1]`, tinted by its color (
glTF `KHR_materials_transmission`). Transmissive materials draw in
the transparent pass; the environment's `refraction` bends what shows
through them.

world_tiling.description:
Lays the maps from the world's axes, one repeat every
this many meters, instead of by texture coordinates:
no seams and one texel density at any size, for surfaces that stay
where they are, such as rocks. In `(0, 10000]`.

SceneSurface.description:
A material's response to light. Omitted fields keep the
matte defaults: roughness 0.8 and no metalness, emission or ripples.

emission.description: Emitted light as a multiple of the material color.

metalness.description: Metals reflect in their own color and diffuse no light.

roughness.description: 0 is a mirror, 1 spreads highlights and sky reflections widest.

SceneTextureMap.description:
A texture map with its sampling and placement. Omitted settings take
glTF's defaults: repeating, trilinear, untransformed.

mipmap_filter.description:
Filtering between mip levels; `none` samples the full-size texture
only.

offset.description:
Texture coordinates are scaled, rotated by `rotation` radians, then
offset.

tex_coord.description:
The texture coordinates the map reads: 0, the mesh's first (the
default), or 1, its second.

SceneTopLayer.description:
A layer settling on a material's faces turned up: its
linear color, how far from straight up it reaches (0 covers nothing, 1
every face turned up at all) and its roughness (default 0.85).

TextureView.description: A texture as a scene authors it and its state.

alive.description:
Whether it is still in the asset library; its other fields are None
once removed.

emission_mask.description: Whether its alpha limits emission to some texels.

gpu_resident.description: Whether it is resident on the GPU; None where no renderer answers.

id.description: Its authored texture ID; None when no scene instance owns it.

inline.description: Whether a scene authored its pixels inline (`rgba8`).

uri.description:
Its image file beside the scene; None for inline pixels and textures
games made.

Mesh3d.description:
The mesh this entity draws and its material: the mesh's authored ID,
source and geometry with what the renderer made of it, the material as a
scene authors it, and the textures its maps read. Missing assets skip
rendering.

drawn_level.description:
The level of detail GPU-culled frames drew it at, read back a few
frames late: 0 the mesh, 1 and 2 its simplifications, 3 its impostor
card. Inspecting watches it: None until a frame after that draws it
with levels of detail, or where no renderer answers.

material.description:
The material as a scene authors it, rebuilt from the one drawing,
every setting stated and its textures by authored ID; None once
removed from the asset library.

mesh.description: The mesh; None once removed from the asset library.

textures.description:
The textures its material's maps read, in map order: base color,
metallic-roughness, normal, occlusion, emissive.

Mesh3d.title: Mesh3dView

NavAgent.description:
Walks its entity over the terrain under it to `destination`. Changing
the destination searches anew; none stands still.

destination.description: Where it walks to: world x and z.

level.description: The pyramid level it searches over: 0 the finest.

max_slope.description: The steepest steps it climbs: rise per meter.

max_water.description: Meters of water it wades through at most.

offset.description: Meters its origin stands above the ground.

turn.description: Degrees a second it turns at most.

NavStatus.description: Where an agent is in its walk.

oneOf.description: Without a destination.
No walk reaches the destination, or no terrain lies under it.

NavAgent.description:
A navigation agent as a scene's `nav_agent` field: it walks over the
terrain to its destination (world x, z) at its speed, on the ground, around
obstacles widened by its radius, no steeper than max_slope, wading no deeper
than max_water; with its walk's status, length, points, next point, meters
left and samples searched. Send it with nav_go.
NavAgent.title: NavAgentView

NavStatus.description: Where an agent is in its walk.

oneOf.description: Without a destination.
No walk reaches the destination, or no terrain lies under it.

NavAgents.description:
What navigation did at the last fixed tick: agents, those searching,
walking, arrived and unable to reach their destination, the samples of
search work the tick did, the walks that failed on workers since
navigation started (each then searched on the engine's thread) and why
the latest did, and the first 16 agents with their status, position,
destination and meters left. Settings: the navigation environment
section.
NavAgents.title: NavAgentsView

samples_per_tick.description:
The samples of search work each fixed tick does at most over every
walk being searched.

OcclusionCulling.description:
Occlusion culling settings: whether GPU-presented frames draw what the
last frame showed, test every other frustum-visible instance against a
depth pyramid of those depths, then draw only what it does not hide.
Output is unchanged; hidden instances cost no drawing. On by default.

enabled.description: Whether GPU-presented frames cull occluded instances.

OcclusionCulling.title: SceneOcclusionCulling

far_radius.description:
Meters the coarser far map reaches, with as many texels: none at
or within `radius`.

radius.description:
Meters around the camera within which covers darken, less over the
outer two fifths.

strength.description: How much of the sky light full cover takes away.

choppiness.description: How sharply crests stand: 0 round swells, 1 nearly breaking.

clarity.description: The meters of water through which half the light passes.

color.description: The color deep water scatters back, linear.

foam.description: How much foam crests and shores gather.

level.description: The height of the still sea, world meters.

reach.description: The meters from the camera the sea draws.

seed.description: The seed of their headings and phases.

wind.description:
The wind that raised it, meters per second along x and z: its speed,
from 0.5 to 30, sets the waves' height and length and its direction
heads them.

SceneParticleBlend.description: How particles combine with what is behind them.

oneOf.description: Covering by alpha, lit by the sun and sky: smoke, dust, rain.
Adding light, unlit: sparks, fire.

Balls of mist, soft through their depth, lit by the sky and the
sun they scatter forward: spray, steam, fog banks.

ParticleEmitter.description:
A particle emitter on this entity.
Omitted fields take the engine's defaults.

acceleration.description: World acceleration: gravity, buoyancy or wind.

blend.description: How particles combine with what is behind them.

color.description: Linear RGBA at birth and at death; alpha fades.

direction.description: Direction of emission in the entity's local space; nonzero.

emission.description: Brightness multiple of the color, for glowing particles.

offset.description: Birth position in the entity's local space.

radius.description: Radius of the ball particles start in.

seed.description: Varies random choices between otherwise identical emitters.

size.description: Diameter at birth and at death, in world units.

speed.description: Initial speed in world units per second.

spread_degrees.description:
Half-angle of the cone of initial directions, in degrees; 180 emits
in every direction.

stretch.description: Seconds of travel particles stretch along their motion.

ParticleEmitter.title: SceneEmitter

max_particles.description:
An optional budget of particles a frame draws; beyond it the emitters
nearest the camera win. Omitted, every emitter draws.

air_density.description:
Kilograms a cubic meter of air weighs: what the wind drags
bodies with.

enabled.description: Whether bodies move; off, each holds where it stands.

gravity.description:
Every body's acceleration, meters per second squared: by default
the pull the terrains' water runs and falls by.

iterations.description:
Constraint solver iterations a tick: more keep stacks and piles
stiffer, at their cost.

water_density.description:
Kilograms a cubic meter of water weighs: bodies in water are
buoyed by the weight of what they displace and dragged with its
current, so those lighter than it float.

PhysicsStats.description: Physics at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

awake.description: Of them, awake: moving, or pushed this tick.

contacts.description: Contacts touching between bodies and solids or each other.

held.description:
Of them, held still where the world's solids under them are not
resident yet.

solids.description:
The world's solids the solver holds for bodies to meet: terrain
tiles, placed objects and colliders near them.

water_samples.description: Samples of the world's water the tick's bodies took.

PhysicsWorld.description:
The physics world at the last fixed tick: its bodies, the world's solids
it holds for them, their contacts and the water samples they took.
PhysicsWorld.title: PhysicsWorldView

PresentationState.description:
Last prepared extraction's frame/tick and actual mode/fraction; null
frame/tick before extraction. Current mode uses alpha one. History counters
measure bounded storage. gpu_pending marks a GPU-presented extraction whose
CPU poses are not materialized. Inspection prepares presentation only to
materialize such a frame; this is not GPU submission/completion or total
process memory.

alpha.description: Actual fraction used at the last extraction; current mode uses one.

frame.description:
Frame at the last prepared extraction; null before the first extraction.
Decimal strings preserve all 64-bit values in JavaScript.

gpu_pending.description:
The last extraction was blended on the GPU and CPU
presented poses still hold earlier values. Inspecting PresentedTransform
materializes that frame first while its inputs are unchanged.

history_bytes.description: Allocated history storage; excludes allocator overhead and other ECS data.

presentation_scratch_bytes.description: Reserved presentation scratch payload; excludes maps and allocator overhead.

presented_store_bytes.description: Reserved canonical presented-pose and entity storage; excludes maps/allocator overhead.

tick.description: Fixed tick at that extraction; does not imply GPU submission/completion.

PresentationState.title: PresentationStateView

PresentedTransform.description:
Last extracted world matrix, including interpolated ancestors; column-major
and preserves shear. Inspection does not recompute it, except to materialize
the exact CPU reference of a GPU-presented frame while its inputs are
unchanged. Null until extracted or when the presented branch is invalid. See
PresentationState for actual mode, alpha and gpu_pending.

matrix.description:
Last extracted world matrix, column-major; inspection rebuilds it only to
materialize a GPU-presented frame.

PresentedTransform.title: PresentedTransformView

Interior.description:
An interior's light, blending in over the probe's blend distance inside
its faces.

sky.description: The share of the sky's light that reaches surfaces inside the box.

sun.description: The share of the sun's light that reaches surfaces inside the box.

ReflectionProbe.description:
A reflection probe on this entity.

Its box is axis-aligned in world space and centered on the entity's
world position, so the entity's rotation and scale leave it unchanged.
Surfaces inside it reflect what the probe captured from its center
(still objects and still lights), fading out over `blend` toward its
faces into the probes around it or the sky.

blend.description:
World distance inside the box's faces over which the probe fades
out.

extent.description: Half the box's size along each world axis in world units.

interior.description:
Makes the box an interior: a cave or a hall letting in
only these shares of the sky's light and the sun's.

ReflectionProbe.title: SceneReflectionProbe

faces_per_frame.description:
Cube faces captured per frame while probes wait: more fill new places
sooner, fewer keep those frames lighter.

max_probes.description:
An optional budget of probes kept captured; beyond it the probes
nearest the camera win. Omitted, as many as the GPU's texture arrays
hold.

resolution.description:
Texels across each face of every environment map, the sky's
included.

Reflections.description:
Screen-space reflections; an intensity
of 0 turns them off.

intensity.description: How strongly glossy surfaces reflect the screen; 0 turns them off.

max_roughness.description: Surfaces rougher than this reflect only the sky.

Reflections.title: SceneReflections

Refraction.description:
Refraction through glass; a strength
of 0 turns it off.

blur.description: Blur radius in pixels that fully rough glass reaches.

strength.description:
Scales how far rays bend through transmissive materials; 0 turns
it off.

Refraction.title: SceneRefraction

oneOf.description: Under gravity, contacts, water and wind: physics writes its pose.

Along the poses written to it, pushing dynamic bodies aside as it
goes: platforms, doors, paddles.

BodyProblem.description: Why physics leaves a body out.

oneOf.description: Its entity has no collider: no shape to move.
Its entity has a parent: bodies move in the world, as roots.
Its entity has no transform: nowhere to stand.
Its transform's scale gives its shape no usable size.

BodyWater.description: The water a body is in.

current.description: The water's velocity at its middle, world meters a second.

submerged.description: The share of its volume below the surface, 0 to 1.

SceneRigidBody.description:
A rigid body: physics moves its entity by gravity, its contacts with
the world's solids (terrain, placed objects, bridge decks and
colliders) and other bodies, and the water and wind about it. Its shape
is its entity's collider, scaled by its transform; its mass is that
shape's volume times its density, so bodies lighter than water float.
Roots only. Each fixed tick physics writes a dynamic body's pose to its
transform, which interpolates between ticks; a pose written to it
since moves it there. Bodies where the ground under them is not
resident hold still until it is.

density.description:
Kilograms a cubic meter: water's is 1000, wood's about 600,
stone's about 2600.

drag.description:
Its drag coefficient: how hard water's current and the wind push
on the area it turns to them.

fast.description:
Swept between ticks, so it stops at thin solids however fast it
moves.

friction.description: How its surface grips what it slides on.

restitution.description: How much of its speed into a contact it bounces back with.

spin.description: Its spin as it joins, radians a second about the world's axes.

velocity.description: Its velocity as it joins, world meters a second.

WaterKind.description:
What kind of water a sample is: a river's, a lake's, a waterfall's jet or
the sea's.

RigidBody.description:
A rigid body as authored, and what physics did with it at the last
fixed tick: whether the solver holds it (not with a problem, nor before
its first tick), its mass (kilograms) and volume (cubic meters), its
velocity (meters a second) and spin (radians a second about the world's
axes), whether it sleeps or holds still where the ground under it is not
resident, and the water it is in.
RigidBody.title: RigidBodyView

SceneBounds.description: A world box (minimum and maximum corners).

Shadows.description: Sun shadows; omitted fields take the engine defaults.

bounds.description:
Region to keep shadows for: the whole scene gives the sharpest,
stable shadows. Without it the maps follow the camera. Corners
finite, `min` at most `max` on every axis.

cascades.description:
Sharper maps (cascades) splitting `near_distance`, each reaching a
third as far as the next; 3 when omitted.

distance.description: Shadows fade out this far from the camera (world units).

level_extent.description:
Side of the finest kept level (world units), which each next level
is four times; 256 when omitted.

levels.description:
Kept levels: maps of still casters following the camera, sharper
than the far maps where they reach, each with half the far maps'
`resolution` per side; none when omitted. Worlds larger than their
shadows' sharpness give them two or three.

near_distance.description:
View distance of the sharper maps that follow the camera, less
than `distance`.

resolution.description: Texels per side of the far maps.

Shadows.title: SceneShadows

Skin.description:
The skin deforming this entity's mesh, as a scene's `skin` names
it: each vertex moves by its weighted joints' displayed world matrices
times their inverse bind matrices.

inverse_binds.description:
How many inverse bind matrices it holds; joints beyond them bind
with the identity.

joints.description: Each joint's authored entity ID; None when not authored.

skin.description: The skin's authored ID; None when no scene instance made it.

Skin.title: SkinView

Sky.description: A physically based sky. Defaults are Earth's. Opt-in.

adaptation.description:
How far exposure adapts to the sky's light, so that dawn, dusk and
night stay readable: 0 not at all, 1 fully.

aerial.description:
How far air hazes what lies away from the camera, as a multiple of
real distance; 0 none.

altitude.description:
The height of the world's origin above the ground of the planet,
meters.

mie_g.description: The forward lobe of Mie scattering's phase.

mie_height.description: The height over which Mie scattering thins by e, kilometers.

ozone.description: Ozone absorption per kilometer at its densest, 25 km up.

rayleigh.description: Rayleigh scattering per kilometer at the ground: red, green, blue.

rayleigh_height.description: The height over which Rayleigh scattering thins by e, kilometers.

sun_intensity.description: The sun's intensity: its color's scale above the air.

Sky.title: SceneSky

SplineMesh.description:
A mesh bent along a curve on this entity as a scene's `spline`
field: copies of the mesh end to end along a centripetal Catmull-Rom curve
through `points` (entity space), its x along the curve, y up and z across,
drawn by child entities a chunk of at most 256 m each; with the curve's
length, copies, chunks and vertices once built, or the error that stopped
it.

mesh.description:
The mesh's and material's authored IDs; None when no scene instance
owns them.

SplineMesh.title: SplineMeshView

StreamedId.description:
The streamed item whose root this entity is: its ID. Despawning the entity
removes the item for good (WorldChanges); its cell no longer spawns it.
StreamedId.title: StreamedIdView

SubpixelCulling.description:
Sub-pixel culling settings: whether GPU-presented frames leave visible
instances whose projected bounds cover no pixel center undrawn. They
could produce no fragments, so output is unchanged. On by default.

enabled.description: Whether GPU-presented frames cull sub-pixel instances.

SubpixelCulling.title: SceneSubpixelCulling

SunShafts.description:
Sun shafts: sunlight scattered by the fog between shadow
casters. Requires shadows; an intensity of 0 turns them
off.

anisotropy.description: Forward scattering: higher concentrates light toward the sun.

distance.description: World distance along each view ray light is gathered over.

intensity.description: How bright the shafts are; 0 turns them off.

SunShafts.title: SceneSunShafts

TemporalAntialiasing.description:
Temporal antialiasing settings: whether ordinary GPU-presented frames
jitter and resolve against their history. Its targets cost 16 bytes per
canvas pixel while it runs. Off by default.

enabled.description: Whether ordinary GPU-presented frames resolve temporally.

TemporalAntialiasing.title: SceneTemporalAntialiasing

ErosionView.description:
A terrain's erosion bake: whether a bake is in progress
(tiles wait for it), and once done the samples it eroded, its rounds
and the most it wore away and filled (meters).

FallView.description:
A waterfall, terrain-local: its lip's water and where its jet lands, the
river's width at the lip, the water's landing speed (meters a second)
and the discharge it carries (cubic meters a second).

HydrologyView.description:
A terrain's hydrology bake: whether it is in progress
(tiles wait for it), and once done the samples it read, those channels
run through, those of filled pits, the largest area draining through
one (square meters), the waterfalls rivers drop over, how its rivers and
lakes flow and its first falls.

PathView.description:
A path layer: its index in the stack, whether its
profile is baked, and once baked its length (meters), the points its
profile read the ground at, its steepest grade (rise per meter), the
most it cuts into and fills over the ground along its line off bridges
(meters), its bridges and the meters they span, and its
tunnels and the meters they run.

RiverFlowView.description:
How a terrain's rivers flow, as its bake solved them: rivers, lakes,
river points, the largest discharge (cubic meters a second), the fastest
mean speed (meters a second), the share of points running faster than
their waves (Froude number over one) and of points carrying foam (over a
tenth).

Stamp.description:
A local edit: full strength within `radius` meters of `center`, fading
out over `falloff` meters beyond.

center.description: Terrain-local meters along x and z.

falloff.description: Meters beyond the radius over which it fades out.

op.description: What it does where it reaches.

radius.description: Meters around the center at full strength.

StampOp.description:
What a stamp does where it reaches: raise or lower heights by meters,
level them toward a height, or cut holes in the terrain.

oneOf.description:
Cells whose centers lie within the radius are holes: no surface
draws or collides there.

SurroundingsView.description: A terrain's surroundings as they stream.

TerrainEditView.description: One terrain edit: its id and its stamp (terrain-local).

Terrain.description:
A heightfield terrain on this entity as a scene's `terrain` field:
its origin, tiles, spacing, layers or file, material, collision and
surroundings, with its streaming state: resident tiles by level, and its
surroundings' once they stream.

edits.description:
Its edits, in order: each one's `id` and its `stamp`,
terrain-local, which a scene saves as a `{"stamp": ...}` layer after
its others.

erosion.description: Its erosion bake, when its layers hold one.

hydrology.description: Its hydrology bake, when its layers hold one.

level_errors.description:
Per level, finest first: the most meters its height differs from
the next coarser level's, which its patches morph by (0 until
measured), and meters from the eye it draws to.

paths.description: Its path layers, in stack order.

surroundings.description:
Its surroundings once they stream, after its bakes:
how far they reach past its edges along x and z, their level-0 tiles
along a side and sample spacing, and their resident tiles and the
patches drawn.

terrain.description:
The terrain as a scene's `terrain` field: `SceneTerrain` of
the SceneDocument schema (describe SceneDocument).

Terrain.title: TerrainView

TerrainView.description:
What terrain shows: its material, or for development its
levels of detail, normals or tiles and patches.

oneOf.description: Each surface material in its own color, blended as the ground is.

The share of the sky the ground sees, unlit, from
black (none) to white (all of it).

How much detail the ground shows: green where all
its maps show, yellow where their color alone does, red where their
means stand in, blue where it shows as its cover's canopy.

TerrainDebug.description:
What terrain streaming and level of detail follow, and what terrain
shows: the `terrain` control's state.

freeze.description: Where streaming is frozen; None follows the camera.

TerrainDebug.title: TerrainDebugView

TerrainPrefetch.description:
Names a place the camera may be sent to, such as a spawn point:
while the view wants nothing, workers generate the terrain tiles a camera
there wants into memory, as they do ahead of the camera, and those tiles
stay there while it is named, so the camera sent there finds them at once.

reach.description:
Each level's tiles within this many times its range; 2 is what a
camera there loads.

TerrainPrefetch.title: TerrainPrefetch

SceneTerrainMotionDetail.description:
How terrain loads while the camera moves fast: the
finest levels' tiles in its view wait, more of them the faster it
moves, and tiles out of its view wait until it settles. The coarsest
pinned levels, collision's tiles and those under focus entities never
wait, and tiles resident stay.

fastest.description:
Meters per second at which the finest `levels` levels wait, at least
`speed`; between, fewer wait, at least one.

levels.description: Finest levels whose tiles wait at `fastest`.

settle.description:
Seconds after the camera slows below `speed` before tiles out of its
view load.

speed.description: Meters per second above which the camera moves fast.

cache_bytes.description:
Bytes of tiles kept in memory after the view leaves them,
about 600 KB each, to return at once when it comes back: the
least recently used beyond drop, and 0 keeps none.

collision_radius.description:
Meters around the camera and focus entities within which level-0
tiles load for collision.

gpu_materials.description:
Tiles' surface materials from the GPU: tiles generate
without control values, which a compute pass gives each as it
uploads, the rules' own but where GPU rounding crosses a threshold;
gameplay reads the rules at the points it asks. Off, the CPU gives
them.

idle_reach.description:
Multiples of each level's range within which workers generate tiles
ahead of the view into memory while nothing is missing; within the
keeping reach (2.5) none.

loading_work_ms.description:
Milliseconds a frame works on terrain until the camera's view first
loads whole: loading takes large slices of frames.

max_bands.description:
The most bands of rows a tile under the view generates in at once
on workers the other such tiles leave free; 1 generates whole tiles.

max_tiles.description:
An optional budget of resident tiles (about 270 KB each, twice that
on the GPU); the least important beyond it drop.

motion_detail.description:
Detail lowered while the camera moves fast: off by
default, as it lowers detail in motion on purpose.

pinned_levels.description:
The coarsest levels kept resident over the whole terrain, so it
always draws whole.

pixel_error.description:
Pixels a level's samples span before the next coarser level takes
over; smaller draws more triangles.

relief_distance.description:
Meters from the camera within which the ground's relief shows, its
view rays marching through its materials' heights; 0 none.

relief_steps.description: The most steps a relief ray takes.

samples_per_frame.description:
Work generated, decoded or baked between checks of the frame's work
time, in samples' worth (67,000 a decoded tile, about 500,000 a
generated one); a frame's whole work where hosts give terrain no
clock.

shadow_resolution.description: Texels along a horizon map's sides, 8 bytes each.

shadow_softness.description:
Shadow edge height per meter to the slope casting it (the sun's disc
gives 0.0093).

sky_resolution.description: Texels along a sky visibility map's sides, 4 bytes each.

sky_visibility.description:
Ambient light on terrain scaled by how much sky its ground sees:
each terrain's sky visibility map, built once its
finest pinned level is resident, where valleys and hollows see less
sky and take their own light back instead.

sun_shadows.description:
Long sun shadows through each terrain's horizon map,
with shadows on; shadow maps then draw terrain near the camera only.
Off, terrain casts into the shadow maps alone.

surroundings.description:
Ground generated around terrains with surroundings
streams and draws; off, every terrain ends at its edges.

upload_bytes.description:
Bytes of tiles becoming resident in a frame, which the GPU takes in
that frame, about 540 KB a tile: tiles beyond wait for the next,
though each frame's first arrives whatever its size.

virtual_texture.description:
The runtime virtual texture: the ground's materials
baked into pages the views ask for, which pixels read in place of
computing them; ground finer than its texels, steep ground and pages
not baked yet compute theirs.

virtual_texture_bakes.description:
Pages it bakes in a frame at most, about 0.1 ms each on an
integrated GPU.

virtual_texture_pages.description:
An optional budget of pages it keeps (about 340 KB each). Omitted,
it keeps as many as the views ask for, up to the device's texture
array layers; beyond either, pages unasked for a while make room,
and those asked for with none left drop (the ground computes
itself).

work_ms.description:
Milliseconds a frame works on terrain after: play takes small
slices.

FallView.description:
A waterfall, terrain-local: its lip's water and where its jet lands, the
river's width at the lip, the water's landing speed (meters a second)
and the discharge it carries (cubic meters a second).

LakeView.description:
A lake: its level, its area (square meters), its middle and a point of
its shore (world space).

PoolView.description:
Water held back behind solids in a river: where it stands (world
space, its level), how far above the river's baked water, what flowed
in and out at the last fixed tick (cubic meters a second), the share of
the river's width the solids block and their highest crest (world
height; none once they are gone and it drains), and the water surface
it covers (square meters).

RiverFlowView.description:
How a terrain's rivers flow, as its bake solved them: rivers, lakes,
river points, the largest discharge (cubic meters a second), the fastest
mean speed (meters a second), the share of points running faster than
their waves (Froude number over one) and of points carrying foam (over a
tenth).

RiverSight.description:
A point of a river worth looking at (`largest`, `rapids` or
`confluence`): where its water stands (world space), the way it runs,
half its width, its speed, discharge and foam.

TerrainWaterView.description:
A terrain's water in world space: how its rivers and lakes flow, its
first [`FALLS_SHOWN`] falls, its largest lakes and where its rivers carry
most, run fastest against their waves and meet.

blocks.description: Solids resting on its rivers' beds at the last fixed tick.

pools.description: The water they hold back, and pools still draining.

Terrains.description:
Terrain streaming at the last extraction: terrains; resident, loading,
shape-only, waiting, kept, restored and idle, banded and dropped tiles;
patches drawn and those standing in for finer levels; and the surroundings'.
Query heights with terrain_height, compare queries, collision and layers
with terrain_sweep, and find routes for path layers with terrain_route.

baking.description: Terrains whose bakes are in progress.

banded_tiles.description:
Tiles that generated in bands of rows on several workers since
terrains started.

bridges.description:
Bridges terrains' roads span, tunnels they bore,
and waterfalls their rivers drop over.

cached_tiles.description:
Tiles kept in memory after the view left them and
their bytes, tiles returned from there since terrains started, and
tiles generating ahead of the view.

failed_jobs.description:
Terrains' jobs that failed on workers since each terrain arrived
(after several, a terrain generates its tiles itself), and why the
latest did.

failed_reads.description:
Tile reads that failed since terrains started (read again later),
and why the latest did.

shaped_tiles.description:
Of the resident tiles, those holding their shape alone so far:
drawn with coarser levels' materials while the rest
loads.

surroundings_tiles.description: Of the resident tiles and patches, those of terrains' surroundings.

unplaced_tiles.description:
Resident tiles lacking objects their levels place with nothing
under way to place them: none unless streaming lost track of them.

waiting_tiles.description: Tiles the view wants that wait while the camera moves fast.

water.description:
The first terrain whose hydrology bake is done: how its rivers flow
and its first falls (world space).

Terrains.title: TerrainsView

latitude.description: The latitude that, with the day, sets the sun's path.

north.description: The yaw of north in the world: degrees from -z toward +x.

speed.description: How many hours pass each second; 0 holds it.

step.description: The minutes of each step the sun moves by.

Tint.description:
Per-object color factors as a scene's `tint` field: red, green, blue
and opacity multiply this object's material or cube color, each in [0, 1].
Changing it uploads only this object's colors.
Tint.title: TintView

Track.description:
One stamp: a capsule over the ground from world `from` to `to` (x and
z) of `radius` meters (0.01 to 50), sinking ground as deformable as that
`depth` meters along its middle line (0 to 10), round (`flatness` 0) to
flat (1), pressed at simulation time `seconds`.

latest.description: The newest stamp: where tracks are being made.

Tracks.title: TracksView

Transform.description:
Local transform relative to Parent, or world transform for a root.
Quaternion is normalized XYZW; authored scale is positive and nonsingular.
Transform.title: TransformView

VirtualGeometry.description:
Virtual geometry settings: whether meshes built as cluster
hierarchies draw the clusters each view needs, and how coarse those may
be.

enabled.description: Whether meshes with clusters draw as virtual geometry.

pixel_error.description:
The largest simplification error a drawn cluster may show, in pixels
of the viewport height: smaller draws more triangles.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the camera's clusters shade through the visibility buffer,
each pixel once; false shades them as they draw,
which was faster on the integrated GPU measured. Omitted, false.

VirtualGeometry.title: SceneVirtualGeometry

clarity.description: The meters of water through which half the light passes.

color.description: The color deep water scatters back, linear.

foam.description: How much foam shores and rapids gather; 0 none.

foam_width.description: The meters of water shallower than which shores foam.

ripple_size.description: The meters across the largest ripples.

ripples.description: How strongly ripples tilt the surface.

gusts.description: How strongly gusts traveling with the wind vary its push.

velocity.description: Horizontal velocity: x and z, meters per second.

StreamedCellView.description:
One streamed cell: its grid (0 small, 1 medium, 2
large), its key along x and z, its items and their entities, whether it
is loaded, and its meters from the nearest streaming source.

StreamingGridView.description:
One streaming grid: its cells' side, the meters within
which they load (before the settings' distance), the most an item in
it reaches, and its cells and those loaded.

WorldCells.description:
World streaming at the last extraction: cells holding streamed items, loaded
and pending (within range, waiting), items, entities streamed items hold,
the frame's spawns and despawns, the camera velocity prefetch followed, each
grid's cells and the 32 cells nearest a streaming source. Settings: the
world_streaming environment section.
WorldCells.title: WorldCellsView

WorldChanges.description:
What gameplay changed of the streamed world, which games save: items removed
for good (an item is removed when gameplay despawns its root), by ID
(`scene/root` for scenes), which their cells no longer spawn. The count and
the first 64 IDs. Change it with the world_changes control.
WorldChanges.title: WorldChangesView

distance.description: How far cells load, as a multiple of each grid's range.

enabled.description: Whether streamed items load at all: off unloads every cell.

frozen.description:
Whether cells stay as they are, loading and unloading nothing, for
captures and inspection.

prefetch.description: The seconds ahead along the camera's motion cells load early for.

spawns_per_frame.description:
The entities a frame spawns at most, pacing loads: cells spawn
whole, and at least one a frame.

unload.description:
How much farther than that every source must be before a loaded
cell unloads, as a multiple.

CollisionFilterRequest.description:
Layer matching is symmetric: query memberships intersect collider filter,
and collider memberships intersect query filter. Exclusion uses a live ID
in the supplied active scene; no runtime entity handle is accepted.

CollisionShapeRequest.description:
Query geometry dimensions are world units. No scale or rotation changes occur
during a cast; sphere/cuboid transform admission matches native collision.

level.description: The finest pyramid level it walks.

margin.description: The meters around the walk's ends it may stray.

max_samples.description:
The most samples a walk searches, beyond which it walks a coarser
level.

max_slope.description: The steepest step it climbs: rise per meter.

max_water.description: The deepest water it wades, meters.

radius.description: Its radius, by which obstacles widen, meters.

protocol.description:
Versioned, read-only requests processed synchronously between frames.
Transport/session identity and execution controls belong to the host.

parent.description: Select direct children by their parent's authored ID; excludes entity.

oneOf.description:
The world's content as hashes that depend on neither entity ids nor
spawn order: per component inspector, the entities holding it and a
hash of their views; per kind of asset, the count and a hash of
their contents; and one hash of both. After the same ticks of the
same scene, equal digests mean equal state.

The spread of measured `values` as every host computes it: the
smallest and largest, and the median, 95th and 99th percentiles,
each interpolated linearly between the two sorted values around its
rank; `null` without values, or with one that is not a finite number
of at least 0.

definition.description:
With `SceneDocument`: one definition of the scene schema, which
is too large for one response; without it, the schema's top
level and the names of its definitions.

oneOf.description: Closest authoritative hit; rejects incomplete native candidate scans.
Complete bounded shape overlap, using a world-space rigid query pose.
Closest translation-only shape cast; orientation stays fixed along the ray.

Terrain surfaces under world points `[x, z]`: each one's terrain, height, normal, hole and the level of the
resident tile answering, what its hydrology bake found there and the
water standing there, and the meters from the
nearest road's edge (negative on roads, null beyond
their masks' reach), or null where no tile is resident.

The shortest walk over a generated terrain from world `from` to `to`
`[x, z]`: across ground an agent stands on (no holes,
no water deeper than `max_water`, no closer than `radius` to placed
objects that collide on resident tiles), each step no steeper than
`max_slope` (rise per meter), pulled taut and following the ground.
It walks pyramid `level` (0 by default) unless the area within
`margin` meters of the ends holds more than `max_samples` samples,
then the finest level within. Returns its points (world, rounded to
centimeters), length, the level walked and samples searched, or a
null walk where none reaches.

The sea's surface over world points `[x, z]` at simulation time `seconds` (by default the time the last frame
presented), as frames draw it: its height, normal, how much the waves
compress it there (1 still, toward 0 on sharpening crests, where foam
gathers) and the still sea's point the waves moved there, or null
without a sea; the ground below where a terrain tile is resident,
and the water's depth over it; and the world's water there as
everything meeting it reads it (rivers, lakes or the sea at the fixed
tick: kind, surface, depth, velocity and foam), or null where dry.

The tracks deformers and agents pressed at world points
`[x, z]`, refilled to simulation time `seconds` (by default
the time the last frame presented), as the log holds them: how deep
the deepest sinks deformable ground (`track`) and how high rims raise
it (`rim`); where a tile is resident, the most its surface materials
let tracks sink it (`deform`), the depth it shows (`depth`, the
lesser) and the ground's height. Also the stamps the log holds and
those its budget dropped.

Compares, over `samples` by `samples` points across `half_extent`
meters of world `center` `[x, z]`, what terrain queries (the tiles
renderers draw), collision rays and generated terrains' layers say
the ground is: the largest differences and where.

The cheapest route over the generated terrain under world `from`
`[x, z]` to world `to`, over its layers with their
bakes, as a path layer would follow it: walking between the samples
of pyramid `level`, each step's cost growing by `grade_cost` times
its squared grade and by `water_cost` where water stands, each turn
costing `turn_cost` meters per unit of one less its angle's cosine,
refusing grades steeper than `max_grade` (rise per meter).
Returns the terrain's origin `[x, z]` and the route's points
terrain-local (a path layer's `points`; add the origin for world
points), its length, its steepest grade within the limit and the
turning steps of its hairpins crossing steeper ground (up to 45
degrees), or a null route where none keeps within the limits. Its
work grows with the square of the ends' distance.
Non-consuming page of the latest fixed-tick sensor transition snapshot.

protocol.title: DevRequest
